text.zh-CN: 阑尾炎是与大肠相连的小管状盲袋——阑尾——发生炎症。常见表现是持续加重的腹痛，可能先在肚脐周围、再移到右下腹，伴食欲减退、恶心或发热，需要及时到医院判断。
text.en: Appendicitis is inflammation of the appendix, a small blind-ended pouch attached to the large bowel. Pain often worsens and may move from around the navel to the lower right abdomen, with poor appetite, nausea or fever; hospital assessment is needed promptly.
